_comment: One disposition and one owner for every Dockerfile in the repository (#346). PUBLISHED = pushed to a registry by release.yml; must be built, scanned, SBOM'd and signed, and the release must consume the tested digest. DISTRIBUTED = built from this repo by an operator or a shipped script but never pushed to a registry; must be built and scanned in CI, but has no published digest to sign. INTERNAL = built only by this repository's own CI or test tooling and never run outside it; must justify itself in prose. RETIRED = superseded; names what replaced_by it and the issue that owns its removal. Checked by scripts/check-image-inventory.py: every Dockerfile on disk must appear exactly once, no entry may name a Dockerfile that is not on disk, and every PUBLISHED or DISTRIBUTED entry must name workflow jobs that actually exist. Adding an image without its jobs fails CI -- that is the point.

images.rationale: The maistro-engine API image. Chainguard/Wolfi runtime, browser surface deliberately split out into Dockerfile.research so this one can go near-zero-CVE.
The Agent Conductor image: frontend build plus a Chainguard/Wolfi runtime over a self-contained venv.

The RESEARCH worker: browser-use + Playwright + Chromium on a Debian base. Its own header calls the browser surface 'the single largest remaining CVE source', which is why it was split out of the API image -- so it is the image that most needs scanning, and was the one not scanned. Operators build it where the web tool actually runs; nothing pushes it, so there is no published digest to sign.

Full-isolation RSI runner: the entire self-improvement loop executes inside it and agent-authored code only ever runs there, so its contents are a containment boundary rather than a convenience. Built by tools/run_rsi_isolated.sh and tools/run_rsi_evolve_isolated.sh on an operator's machine; never pushed.

Docker Sandboxes template, built host-side by deploy/sbx/build.sh. It is FROM docker/sandbox-templates:shell-docker and copies preseed tars that build.sh produces in the same run, so CI cannot build it from a checkout alone -- there is nothing for a scan job to build. Scanning it needs the preseed step first, which is its own piece of work; tracked on #346 rather than claimed here.
The image RSI's nested test containers run under --network=none. Built by the same deploy/sbx/build.sh pass as sbx-template and shares its precondition; same reason it is not yet scanned, same owner.

Five lines: pytest and httpx over the e2e directory. Built only by packages/hive-conductor/docker-compose.test.yml's api-tests service, runs only this repository's own tests, never leaves CI or a developer's machine.
The browser half of the same e2e harness, built only by docker-compose.test.yml's playwright service. Same reasoning as hive-conductor-e2e-api.

Orphaned: no workflow, compose file, script or document references it. It also carries exactly the anti-pattern #351 exists to remove -- `pip install -r requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || pip install fastapi uvicorn httpx pydantic bcrypt`, which swallows the failure and silently installs five unpinned packages instead. It is inventoried rather than deleted here because removal is #351's scope; being listed is what keeps it visible until then.
